text:
(Image)

On horseback in the world's fifth,
a player played yes and no.

Colored rains
migrated to the country of flowers.

Flocks of flowers,
flowers of yes,
flowers of no.

Knives in the air,
that slash his flesh,
form a bridge.

Yes.
No.

The dreamer rides,
harlequin birds

sing yes,
sing no.
